notes.title: Update on the Upcoming Demo
notes.content: [p]First of all — thank you again for all your amazing support and excitement for [i]Magic World[/i]. Your feedback has been a huge source of motivation for us.[/p][p]We need to be honest with you — our original plan was to deliver the big August update with new content. Unfortunately, due to unexpected delays from our artist and VFX specialist, we won’t be able to hit that timeline. The good news is: this doesn’t affect our main goal. The demo will absolutely be ready for [b]Steam Next Fest this October[/b].[/p][p]We’re truly sorry for the delay and hope you understand. Quality takes time, and we’d rather give you something polished and magical than rush it.[/p][p]Thank you for your patience — we promise the wait will be worth it. The journey continues, and October will be a big milestone for [i]Magic World[/i].[/p]

notes.title: What’s next in Magic World? Spoiler: it’s gonna be wild
notes.content:
Huge thanks to everyone who jumped in to test our unique spell-casting system! The main goal was to find out if the mechanics feel good and if casting spells this way is actually fun. Judging by your feedback — it totally is. Massive shoutout for all the comments, suggestions, and DMs — we read everything!

Now, let’s talk future.

Right now, we’re hard at work preparing the demo for Steam Next Fest this October. In its current state, the game isn’t ready to be shown — so we’re making some serious upgrades. And already in August, a huge update is coming your way. Here’s what to expect:

[list]
[*] Dedicated servers — smoother, more stable gameplay
[*] A new 1km demo world — compact but packed with content
[*] A piece of the main storyline — continued in the full game
[*] Side quests — plenty to explore beyond the main story
[*] Character creation — name your hero, make them yours
[*] Progression and skill upgrades — grow stronger with time
[*] Party and clan system — play together, conquer together
[*] NPCs to fight or take quests from — the world’s alive
[*] More spells — try out different combos and effects
[*] Simplified inventory — quick and easy to manage
[*] A boss — big, mean, and ready to test your magic
[/list]

And that’s just the beginning. There’s a lot more to come.
Keep sharing your thoughts, ideas, and feedback — we’re building something truly magical together.

notes.title: Demo Version 0.01 of Magic World is Out!
notes.content:
Friends, today I’m happy to present the first demo version of Magic World 0.01! This is a prototype of the future game, and at this stage, we are testing the core gameplay mechanics.

⚙️ What’s available now: 
— Play with friends (via LAN or direct connection)
— Battle against bots
— Training mode to learn the controls and magic system

💡 Important:
There is no open world yet, as there will be in the full version. However, even the demo version will receive a limited but explorable map in future updates.

🖥️ We also plan to launch a dedicated server to make multiplayer more stable and accessible.

🔥 This is just the beginning — the demo will be regularly updated! Stay tuned, share your feedback, and help us make Magic World even better!

notes.title: Release Demo v0.001
notes.content:
Magic World Demo Version 0.001 Release Date: 01.04.2025!
The first demo version of Magic World will feature:

✅ Tutorial Mode – learn the basics of controls and the magic system.
✅ Single-player Mode – battle against advanced AI bots.
✅ Multiplayer Mode – challenge other players in magical duels.
✅ Core Combat Mechanics – experience the unique spellcasting system.
✅ Over 10 Different Spells – experiment with various combinations.
✅ Battle Arena – a place for epic magical battles.

💡 Important! The main goal of this demo is to test the combat mechanics. We plan to release monthly updates, improving the game and adding new content.

📢 Your feedback is important to us! Share your thoughts, suggestions, and report any bugs on the forum. Your ideas will help us make the game even better!
